acceptance: KNOWN_PLATFORMS is computed from the platform registry (no second hardcoded list).
A test fails before the change and passes after it: every registered platform name, including Apache Doris, validates as known.
A test proves a name absent from the registry is still rejected.
context: Evidence at develop d2deb280e. Not part of the throughput remediation batch.
description: benchbox/validation/bundle.py:401 hardcodes KNOWN_PLATFORMS, and the check at bundle.py:1428 rejects any platform not in it. The set lacks 13 or more registered platforms, including "Apache Doris", so a valid bundle from those engines is flagged as an unknown platform. Found while admitting the Apache Doris throughput bundle into the results corpus (2026-10-08). Replace the hardcoded set with a value derived from the platform registry so new platforms cannot drift out of it.
